drug_family: All21 drugs from frozen expansion family; no new drug selection
gene_universe: Frozen897 common measured landmarks intersect human RMA matrix:876, exact Entrez mapping
human_profile_definition: Difference of mean log2 RMA expression. Continuous positive and negative logFC weights each normalized to sum1. No top-gene cutoff or FDR selection
cardiac_endpoint: Within-sample percentile ranks over the same876 genes, drug-minus-control rank vector; equal wells within culture then equal matched cultures within donor. Reversal=DOWN-weighted rank change minus UP-weighted rank change
primary_test: Per drug intersection-union test: maximum of three one-sided exact donor sign-flip P values for all three endpoints>0; BH across21 IUT P values. BY sensitivity also reported
assumption: Independent donor effect vectors; each tested scalar difference symmetric around0 under null. Conditional on estimated human profiles; no causal randomization claim
human_bootstrap: Resample patients independently within each of four human groups; reuse same resampled nonfailing mean in all three profiles. Recalculate all weights, score fixed cardiac donor-mean rank changes
bootstrap_interpretation: Human-profile stability only, not posterior efficacy probability or combined donor+human confidence interval
sensitivities: same-universe equal-weight top50 genes per direction ranked by absolute logFC, irrespective of gene-level P
exploratory_followup_gate: Original expansion average bidirectional pattern; all three primary endpoint means positive; all three positive after each leave-one-donor omission, QC-flag human removal and top50 sensitivity; joint positive frequency>=0.80 in human bootstrap
formal_specificity_gate: IUT BH q<0.05 and all three mean effects positive; does not upgrade original therapeutic evidence
decision_rule: If neither formal specificity gate nor exploratory followup gate is passed, stop escalation of current sepsis-specific single-drug mechanism claim; preserve comparative study. Passing exploratory gate permits only independent followup hypothesis
original_screen_status: No original FDR-supported therapeutic candidate; remains unchanged
known_results: All21 prior drug scores known. New comparison rule fixed before specificity scores. This is post-screen exploratory specificity work, not prospective confirmation
